subject.title: Feature Request: Inline media display in chat (images, audio, video, web previews)

question: What Control UI media policy should OpenClaw support for remote images, audio/video, and web previews now that direct tool-result images are fixed on current main?
rationale: The remaining behavior changes browser fetch and local media boundaries, so code inspection cannot choose the security posture or user consent model safely without maintainer intent.

options.title: Split into policy-approved slices
options.body: Keep local/direct media rendering, then implement remote images, audio/video behavior, and web previews as separate reviewed slices with explicit CSP/proxy/opt-in rules.

options.title: Allow broad inline previews by default
options.body: Implement remote images and link previews directly in chat, accepting a larger privacy and security review burden for default browser fetches.

options.title: Close the umbrella and track only narrow reports
options.body: Treat the remaining work as separate issues such as remote Markdown images and audio autoplay, leaving web previews for a future product proposal.

recommendation.title: Split into policy-approved slices
recommendation.body: Keep local/direct media rendering, then implement remote images, audio/video behavior, and web previews as separate reviewed slices with explicit CSP/proxy/opt-in rules.

likelyOwner.reason: The unresolved decision centers on Control UI CSP, Gateway media exposure, and safe defaults, where the history points to `steipete` as the adjacent CSP/security owner.
